description: Search public posts by keywords, read FRESH at request time, optionally inside a date window and sorted by relevance or recent. Returns the first 1,000 results per query; page with `start`. Costs $0.0012 per live read. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

start.description: Zero-based offset into the first 1,000 results.
